**The native build of 1.3.0-beta.3.** It's the same code as 1.3.0-beta.3, published so panels on the **Native** channel get it. The updater has now been rewritten in Rust as well, so with `rust` in `/etc/flytower/agent` all of the root-side work runs in Rust: every job the system helper does, plus updates and rollbacks. It's still off unless you switch it on.

Testing: on a spare VPS, switch Rust on, then follow [Testing the Rust agent](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/native-1.3.0-beta.3.native.1/docs/testing/testing-rust-agent.md), including the update and rollback checks.
